general.name: Windows 11 - Apply Clean UI Defaults [Win]
general.description:
Applies our standard Windows 11 taskbar, Start, Explorer, privacy and animation preferences to every profile and the Default profile, hides Edge first-run, sets sleep/hibernate on AC to Never, and restarts Explorer.
Source: https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components/tree/main/Scripts/windows-11-apply-clean-ui-defaults-win

variables.name: usrScope
variables.description: All = every existing local profile plus the Default profile. DefaultOnly = only the Default profile, so just users created later get the settings.

variables.name: usrNeverSleepOnAC
variables.description: true = set sleep and hibernate on AC power to Never on the active plan. Display timeout and all on-battery settings are left alone.

variables.name: usrRestartExplorer
variables.description: true = restart Explorer in every logged-on session so the classic context menu and animation changes apply now. false = they apply at next sign-in.

variables.name: usrAllowUnsupportedOs
variables.description: false = refuse to run on anything but a Windows 11 workstation. true = run anyway (Windows 10 / server). Testing only.
